# Source of knowledge-tree.json

- **Tool:** ChatGPT (work), not Codex. The trees of `wiki-ml-zh` and `wiki-dt-zh` came from Codex.
- **Model version:** GPT-6.1 Sol
- **Date:** 2026-11-06
- **Prompt:** [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md), with the 10 images in `images/`
- **Edits:** none. The JSON is saved exactly as the project owner pasted it from ChatGPT.

## Relation to the first ChatGPT tree

A first tree from ChatGPT came back in English and with an invalid relation value, so it was not used. It is kept in [chatgpt-tree/](chatgpt-tree/) for a later cross-language test.

This tree has the same 35 nodes and 52 edges in the same order, with definitions that read as translations of the ChatGPT ones. 41 edges are identical; the other 11 fix `include` (4 edges) or change the direction or relation of an edge (E001, E008, E011, E014, E027, E039, E046). The trees are therefore not independent of each other.
